name: Raphael Neale
bio: A Representative from Maryland; born in St. Mary's County, Md., birth date unknown; resided in Leonardtown; received a limited education; member, State house of delegates in 1798-1804, 1810-1812, 1814-1815; elected as a Federalist to the Sixteenth and Seventeenth Congresses, and reelected as an Adams-Clay Federalist to the Eighteenth Congress (March 4, 1819-March 3, 1825); died in Leonardtown, Md., October 19, 1833.
